about: The hare's ear twitch, a fidget between the states (HUNT_FAMILIES 7): from the idle's crouch the left ear swings out and down, then both ears swing out into a wide V. Two poses of the body's own Ear, played once or twice by time, then back to the idle; a fidget scheduler (game/src/fidget.ts) picks it. The down and up views may be mirrored by the client for the other ear.
